whatAYeaDid: Noted that Councillor P. Hubert had asked the Managing Director, Corporate Services and Chief Human Resources Officer about Council Policy 18(24) (“No-cut” Employment Agreements) and what would constitute a “no-cut” contract, and that staff responded describing the policy and indicating the City does not have any such contracts, though could not speak for local boards and commissions.
quote: That it BE NOTED that Councillor P. Hubert requested the Managing Director, Corporate Services and Chief Human Resources Officer to advise what is stated in Council Policy 18(24) – “No-cut” Employment Agreements and enquired about what constituted a “no-cut” contract and if the City offered lengthy “no-cut” contracts. The Managing Director, Corporate Services and Chief Human Resources Officer relayed the content of Council Policy 18(24), outlined what would constitute a “no-cut” contract and indicated that to the best of her knowledge the City does not have any “no-cut” contracts, but that she could not speak for the local boards and commissions.
